Explore Our Mission

Growing a greener tomorrow

T'Home4PEco — Transitional Home for Peace & Eco-community — is rooted in ecological stewardship, communal peace, and sustainable living. We believe that healing the earth begins with healing ourselves and our communities.

Core Pillars
Our Foundation

The Pillars of T'Home4PEco

🕊️

Peace

Building harmony through dialogue, reconciliation, and grassroots peace-building. We mobilize communities to transform conflict into cooperation and lay foundations for lasting stability.

💧

Water & Sanitation

Securing access to safe water and dignified sanitation. We protect springs, rehabilitate sources, and promote hygiene practices that safeguard health and the environment.

🏥

Health

Strengthening community wellbeing through preventive care, maternal and child health, mental health support, and partnerships with local health facilities.

🌽

Eco Village

Cultivating regenerative farming, agroforestry, and food sovereignty. Our eco-village model integrates maize, indigenous crops, and sustainable land use for thriving rural livelihoods.

👥

Eco Community

Empowering communities with knowledge, skills, and leadership to drive locally owned solutions. Through training, mentorship, and collaboration we build resilient, inclusive societies.

🌳

Environmental Conservation

Restoring ecosystems through tree planting, biodiversity protection, and climate-resilient practices that honor the relationship between people and the land.

Our Purpose

Vision & Mission

Vision

“A healthy, peaceful and secure empowered community of unlimited opportunities for sustainable ecosystem”

Mission

To mobilize grassroots communities, upgrade their traditional approaches to peace building and economic development; mobilize local communities on current ecological, social and cultural situations; transit towards a more inclusive and safe society; build communities of hope, where human dignity is of great value. We work towards regenerative leadership that is gender and environmentally sensitive.

Our Work in Action

Field Projects

Tree Planting Initiative

Sapling handover during our reforestation drive — partners and community members working hand-in-hand to restore forest cover across Machakos.

Community Tree Planting

Grassroots community members come together to plant indigenous trees, rebuilding ecological resilience one seedling at a time.

Land Preparation

Local youth prepare the land for new planting — turning soil, breaking ground, and getting ready for the next growing season.

Water Project

Securing access to safe water — our team works at a rural water source to install pipes that bring clean water to nearby families.

Community Gathering

Families and youth gather for a community session — dialogue, shared learning, and collective decision-making in action.
